summary: Cadrenal Therapeutics filed an 8-K (Items 7.01, 8.01, 9.01) on October 7, 2026, disclosing that its Board authorized a formal strategic process to maximize value of the company and its asset portfolio. Alternatives include licensing or sale of individual assets, development and commercialization partnerships, portfolio transactions, and business combinations. The review is preliminary with no deadline or timetable, and no assurance any transaction results. No advisor, price, stake, premium, or financing terms were named. Watch for process updates, asset-level deals, or a broader sale that could re-rate the thin-cap Nasdaq biotech.
